1.consolidated_definition: Árbol de tronco recio y ramas espinosas cuya madera, dura y fina, es de color amarillento con vetas negras. (Sapotaceae, Sideroxylon cubense).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Tree with a sturdy trunk and thorny branches, whose wood is hard and fine in color yellowish with black veins (Sapotaceae, Sideroxylon cubense).
